body.name: dghf probe sun
body.description: A bright sun-like fire explosion bursting outward from a single point: a white-gold core flashes, then a ring of orange and red flame with sparks expands outward and fades into drifting embers. Pixel art for a 1080p side-scrolling beat 'em up whose characters are about 230 pixels tall; one light from the top left; clean readable shapes. Canvas 384 by 384 pixels, 16 frames at 20 fps, plays once and does not loop, transparent background, anchored at the centre.
